corrections.proposed: gfc-527 (older GFC list code, not a register number)
corrections.why: The list gives gfc-527 as an older Georgia Forestry Commission list number. NHLR's Georgia list in the local cache does not include this tower, so 'US 527' is not a register number.

sources.title: Fire towers are fading into history (archived copy)

notes_for_editor: Only tower-specific source is the tnlandforms statewide list (location, elevation, code). The list numbers it 11, which falls in the 1-72 group the list says is listed from the USGS name database. The caption's topo-map mention does not say which towers it covers, so the story no longer claims that; the name-source point is not confirmed for this tower itself. No build date, status, staffing, access or photo found; anyplaceamerica returned 403 and mapcarta/mapy show only an OSM point. Not on NHLR's Georgia list (29 registered) or FFLOS's Georgia list (2 former sites) in the local cache. Elevation unit inferred as feet (the list has no unit label). Record's registers 'GFC US 527' is a list code rather than a register number: see correction. The 2006 statewide figures are context, not facts about this tower.
